protocol: All model graphs execute on MLX with ORT optimization/CPU fallback disabled. Each mode trains for 150 updates with same-parameter and independent references, functional-input checks and checkpoint recovery. Timings use separate sequential worker processes, ten warmups and 100 measured full updates.
dtype_policy: FP32 external boundary, biases, nonlinearities, loss, local backward, master parameters and Adam moments. BF16 mode rounds the forward matrix operands/results.
summary_storage: Comparison summaries, errors and all 150 losses agree across update modes; one numerical copy is stored per profile/precision. Residency, measurements and checkpoint comparisons are mode-specific.

numerical.reduction: mean over samples; sum over classes

measurement.scope: Independent worker; ten warmup/100 measured full updates. Prepare includes CPU feeds or synchronized Metal binding; execute includes provider wrapping/copy-out; import checks shared output pointers; Adam includes synchronization of parameters and moments. References/checkpoints excluded. RSS covers process/runtime. MLX counters cover the Python allocator and its active baseline; provider allocations use a separate runtime.
